name: Satish Gupta
summary: Since July 2026 I have been a software developer at Victory Financial Consulting Pvt. Ltd. I build the HRMS, the loan site, and VFC Rise. I also ship MERN products for travel, CRM, and real-time chat.
about: I build the public website, the staff panel, and the API they share.
The work is an HRMS and sales CRM, the loan site, and VFC Rise for MSME loans.
I also build travel booking, enterprise CRM, and real-time chat on the MERN stack, with React, Node, Express, MongoDB, and Redux Toolkit.
I completed a B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering from Bihar Engineering University, Patna. Mathematics and physics were my strongest subjects.
points: I ship the screen and the API together, so the customer page and the staff desk stay on the same data.
I start from the record: a lead, a loan file, an employee, or a document. The page comes after that is clear.
AI assistants answer from saved company facts. Live rates, balances, and application status stay in the database.
Calls, WhatsApp, SMS, and file uploads sit on the same record they belong to, not in a separate tool.
I would rather finish one flow, from the button a person presses to the row saved in the database, than leave it half built.
